description: Source file implementing the Blit9 class for surface copy and blitting operations in Direct3D 9, including shader management, state saving/restoring, and texture copying.

classes.name: Blit9
classes.description: Utility class for surface copying, blitting, and format conversion in Direct3D 9 rendering context.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes geometry resources for blitting operations, such as vertex buffer and declaration.

methods.name: setShader
methods.description: Template method to set a shader (vertex or pixel) from precompiled shader code.

methods.name: setVertexShader
methods.description: Sets the vertex shader for blitting.

methods.name: setPixelShader
methods.description: Sets the pixel shader for blitting.

methods.name: getSurfaceRect
methods.description: Retrieves the rectangle dimensions of a surface.

methods.name: getSurfaceSize
methods.description: Retrieves the size (width, height) of a surface.

methods.name: boxFilter
methods.description: Performs a box filter (blurring) operation between source and destination surfaces.

methods.name: copy2D
methods.description: Copies a 2D framebuffer attachment to a surface or texture.

methods.name: copyCube
methods.description: Copies a framebuffer attachment to a cube map face.

methods.name: copyTexture
methods.description: Copies a texture to a surface with optional format conversion and alpha premultiplication.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Performs the actual copy or blit operation between surfaces, using stretch rect or format conversion.

methods.name: formatConvert
methods.description: Converts surface data to a different format with shader-based processing.

methods.name: setFormatConvertShaders
methods.description: Selects and sets appropriate shaders for format conversion based on destination format and alpha handling.

methods.name: copySurfaceToTexture
methods.description: Copies a surface into a texture for further processing.

methods.name: setViewportAndShaderConstants
methods.description: Configures viewport and shader constants for blit operations.

methods.name: setCommonBlitState
methods.description: Sets common render states for blitting operations.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Executes the draw call for the blit quad.

methods.name: saveState
methods.description: Saves current device state to restore later.
